title: Final Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct final expression for the ionization rate W.

title: Hamiltonian Formulation
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly derive the modified Hamiltonian including the interaction term with the vector potential.

title: Perturbation Theory
description: Important Criteria: The student must apply perturbation theory correctly to relate the Hamiltonian to the ionization process.

title: Expectation Value
description: Important Criteria: The student should compute the expectation value of the perturbation correctly between the ground state and the outgoing state.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that the units of the final expression for W are consistent with physical dimensions.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common errors such as sign mistakes or neglecting factors in the Hamiltonian.

title: Coulomb Gauge Application
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply the Coulomb gauge condition in their derivation.

title: Transverse Wave Condition
description: Optional Criteria: The student should recognize and state that the plane wave is transverse as required for electromagnetic waves.
